subject: Logic
title: Moving the Goalposts
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Moving the Goalposts.

hook.text: You meet every demand, and they change the requirements. The target keeps moving.

buildup.text: Moving the goalposts means changing the criteria for proof after the original standard has been met.

discovery.text: "Show me evidence." You do. "That's not enough." You add more. "Well, that's a special case."

twist.text: It signals that the person was never open to changing their mind. The game is rigged.

climax.text: Pin down the criteria upfront: "What evidence would change your mind?" Then hold them to it.

punchline.text: Set the target before the shot.

quiz.question: What does 'moving the goalposts' involve?
options: Changing proof requirements after they're met
